When you say 'freezes your computer', does it freeze until you restart, or does it just freeze for a few minutes?
Try using noscript addon for Firefox by enabling and disabling only certain scripts.

Run Firefox with the following add ons:

Ad Block Plus, UBlock Origin, Ghostery, Privacy Badger, Better Privacy, Block Site,

Also I use Spybot Search and Destroy from the German site. It is particularly good at catching code that pops and tries to run something on your machine. It is also premier at finding anything that does get through your defense if it leaves a trail.

And Finally, the Click and Clean add on, with Clear Browsing Data - clears the cache and history after browsing sessions - 'cause muh porn addiction.

I run them all, and that catches 99.995% of the crap. Better than anti-virus software. A lot of the page freeze occurs when ad related code is trying to contact servers on third party sites and the system is awaiting a reply - a lot of that code is also just plain old shit code. If you block the elements from loading in the first place, then the pages load much faster and it keeps the memory cleaner on your system = fewer browser crashes.

I also block a lot of shit like google and facebook tracking. You can white list the sites you want to support - like VOAT.

I'm not paranoid - just experienced with repairing fucked up computers - better to prevent the corruption from reaching the computer in the first place, so you don't have to clean it out later on.
